verdict.rationale: The pack contains no Honcho statement or control about AI model training: no training opt-out, no no-training policy, and no data-usage terms. The only related item is self-hosting to keep data on your own infrastructure (honcho-docs-9). That is a data-residency feature, adjacent to this story, and it does not establish whether data is used for training, especially since Honcho reasons with external model providers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
